description: This file defines an Angular service 'AuthService' that manages user authentication, including login, logout, profile loading, and session state management via localStorage.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service providing authentication capabilities, session management, and user profile handling.

methods.name: session$
methods.description: Observable stream of the current user session profile.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Boolean getter indicating whether a user session exists based on stored token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login via API, stores token, and updates user profile state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored token and resets user profile state.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Loads the user profile from API and updates the user state.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the user profile via API and updates the user state.
